technical.summary: Bullish momentum with strong moving average alignment and MACD crossover, but weak trend strength (ADX 15.9) and overbought oscillators create pullback risk; suitable for swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: CF shows minimal fundamental support with no insider/institutional activity, zero government contracts, negligible lobbying presence, and earnings arriving in 18 days creating near-term event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional activity and news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) combined with high earnings risk in 18 days and recent FOMC event creates severely unfavourable macro conditions for CF trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD bullish crossover with RSI rising and price above major moving averages provides technical momentum entry in extreme fear zone (VIX 367.2) offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 15.9), overbought oscillators signaling pullback risk, high earnings event in 18 days, zero fundamental support, and unfavorable macro environment (crisis VIX + recent FOMC) create excessive risk relative to reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (MACD crossover, RSI rising) offers contrarian appeal in extreme fear, but earnings in 18 days and weak trend strength (ADX 15.9) create unacceptable event risk for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 18 days combined with overbought oscillators and crisis VIX regime creates high probability of sharp reversal before position can develop.
